dex.text: A warm little glass with a cream cap it is very proud of. Do not stir it. It will know, and it will sulk until it goes cold.
dex.fact: Irish coffee was first made at Foynes in 1943 by chef Joe Sheridan, for passengers off a flying boat that had turned back in a winter storm.

dex.text: Wears a pair of flying goggles and a halo of whiskey steam. Warms frozen travellers whether they want it or not, then floats off to the next table looking pleased.
dex.fact: Joe Sheridan's recipe floats lightly whipped cream on hot sweetened coffee and whiskey, so you drink the hot through the cold.
